pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: No internet. The edit still saves.
Now two phones change the same list offline. Who wins?
Apps built for this keep a copy of your data on the phone and save there first.
Each change waits in a queue.
Back online, the queue syncs through the server.
Additions merge. If both changed the same item, a rule picks one, the same on every copy.
That's local-first: the main copy lives on your phone; servers just keep copies in sync.
